# Standards & federation

Keepiq declares the standards below in its manifest. OpenRegister publishes them to other servers without login, under `keepiq.discovery` in `/ocs/v2.php/cloud/capabilities`, so another instance can tell from a hostname alone whether it can connect. Tools such as [Nextcloud Peek](https://genhttp.dev/lambda/nextcloud-peek/) show it too.

## Standards this app provides

| Standard | Version | Access | Endpoint |
|---|---|---|---|
| [WebAuthn passkeys (vault login)](https://www.w3.org/TR/webauthn-3/) | — | Nextcloud login | — |
| [FIDO Credential Exchange Format (import and export)](https://fidoalliance.org/specifications-credential-exchange-specifications/) | 1.0 | Nextcloud login | — |
| [FIDO Credential Exchange Protocol (relayed transfer)](https://fidoalliance.org/specifications-credential-exchange-specifications/) | — | Nextcloud login | — |
| [OAuth 2.0 JWT bearer grant for application tokens (RFC 7523)](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7523) | — | Token, no login | `/apps/keepiq/api/v1/token` |
| [X.509 certificates from the built-in CA (recipient encryption)](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5280) | — | Nextcloud login | — |
| [Open Cloud Mesh federated secret shares with partner organisations](https://github.com/cs3org/OCM-API) | — | Token, no login | `/ocm/keepiq` |

## Standards this app uses

None.

## Public entry points

| Name | Path |
|---|---|
| discovery | `/apps/keepiq/api/v1/app/.well-known/keepiq` |

## Federation (Open Cloud Mesh)

These resource types are announced in `/.well-known/ocm` when Open Cloud Mesh federation is enabled on the instance.

| Resource type | Share with | Protocols |
|---|---|---|
| `keepiq-secret` | user | keepiq: `/ocm/keepiq` |

## How another server finds this

```bash
curl -s -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true' \
  'https://cloud.example.org/ocs/v2.php/cloud/capabilities?format=json' \
  | jq '.ocs.data.capabilities["keepiq"].discovery'
```

Paths are relative to the instance root. Prefix `/index.php` when the instance runs without pretty URLs (`core.mod-rewrite-working` is false). Endpoints that need a Nextcloud login are listed without their path.

## Administrators

- Stop publishing discovery for every app: `occ config:app:set openregister discovery_public --value=no`
- Hide only this app: add `keepiq` to `occ config:app:set openregister discovery_hidden_apps --value=...` (comma separated)

Field reference and the shared list of standard ids: [Discovery and federation](https://github.com/ConductionNL/openregister/blob/development/docs/Technical/discovery-and-federation.md).
